authors_reviews.title: Definitely an A+ product above and beyond certain other brands.
authors_reviews.text: I thought this would be perfect right off the bat but it takes a couple days to actually be effective beginning of tick season if still was a couple on her but not as much and then as a season tapered down a little bit and the wet rain stopped there wasn't as many and now all of a sudden we haven't found any honor and it's starting to work really really well.She doesn't feel sluggish wearing it that doesn't smell terrible it actually smells pretty good and she doesn't mind wearing it and that's the most important thing.I always get worried about using these kind of collars.We stopped using seresto years ago for reasons I can't really put here, so this is great to find a natural style of flea and tick collar for her.We don't live in a Sandy or Dusty environment or an area that has a lot of fleas so I can attest to whether that would work but I'm certain if it keeps ticks off of her it would surely keep those away.My only reason for not giving it five stars is it is of course plastic it doesn't stay inside the loops so I have to keep adjusting it and I also thought it would work right off the bat and it didn't, as I said it took a little bit of time.I love that you pay a decent price not break the bank for two of them and you get a flea and tick comb which is awesome.Everybody in the house goes to me when there's a tick on an animal or a person I get them off very well so using this mini comb is essential during that process.
authors_reviews.author: Darryl - Upstate NY

authors_reviews.title: Works well
authors_reviews.text: I've used this brand several times over the past couple of years for our big dog. He's a 95-pound pit mix. The large size flea collar is the right size for him, with a little leftover so you know it's a good fit. These collars work well in repelling both fleas and ticks. We've tried the more expensive brands in the past and find these collars to be comparable if not better. Our dog is an outside dog and we live in the woods, so fleas and ticks are a big concern. He has never had to deal with either pest. Definitely a great purchase and will protect your beloved puppy from the health problems caused by fleas and ticks.
authors_reviews.author: Frequent Shopper
